Meteorology

Предупреждение о тропическом шторме

An official advisory issued to warn vessels that a tropical storm may affect the area within 48 hours. Mariners should closely monitor forecasts and prepare for possible severe weather.

Quick answer: An official advisory issued to warn vessels that a tropical storm may affect the area within 48 hours. Mariners should closely monitor forecasts and prepare for possible severe weather.

What is Предупреждение о тропическом шторме?

In this glossary, Предупреждение о тропическом шторме refers to: An official advisory issued to warn vessels that a tropical storm may affect the area within 48 hours. Mariners should closely monitor forecasts and prepare for possible severe weather.

How is Предупреждение о тропическом шторме used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "VTS всем судам: Предупреждение о тропическом шторме, ожидается в районе плавания в течение 48 часов. Следите за обновлениями и сообщайте о готовности."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

An official advisory issued to warn vessels that a tropical storm may affect the area within 48 hours. Mariners should closely monitor forecasts and prepare for possible severe weather.

Operational example

VTS to all ships: Tropical Storm Watch in effect, expected to impact navigation area within 48 hours. Monitor updates and report readiness status.

Localized term

Предупреждение о тропическом шторме

Localized example
